baseline.method: Independent unmodified public consensus VB core, fixed200updates, coherent nativeViterbi withposteriorstart, all590nativeL1-L9traces

reference_role: Validated published-method result, not independently measured molecular states

metric_definitions.path_agreement: fraction identical on all 64281 native valid frames after one consistent ensemble label permutation
metric_definitions.transition_max_abs: maximum absolute probability per frame difference
metric_definitions.population_max_abs: maximum absolute posterior frame occupancy difference
metric_definitions.observation_loglikelihood_per_frame: sum independent sequence Gaussian-HMM log likelihood / 64281
metric_definitions.decoder_agreement: fraction identical to independent joint Viterbi decoding under submitted start/transition/emission quantities

tolerance_rationale: Frozen before extraction; repeated original100/200 fixed points differ below 7e-15; 1e-5 parameter limits and 0.995 path fraction allow numerical rounding while requiring every output and likelihood consistency. Not physical state accuracy.
canonicalization: Sort estimated emission means ascending, apply same permutation to paths, all state vectors, and both transition axes. No per-trace alignment.
definition: Point-parameter HMM joint log posterior with the public Normal-Gamma and uniform Dirichlet priors, all independent sequences, compared one-sided to the attained standard value within1e-8 per observed frame. This is not claimed to equal the historical variational ELBO. Original measured likelihood and own-model Viterbi checks retained. Population is checked against own-model forward-backward posterior occupancy to max(1e-6,1.1 times attained standard discrepancy). No parameter/path-array reference identity.
